USER_CONTEXT: Fix dotenv `set_key` so quote_mode='always'/'auto' round-trips literal backslashes (including consecutive backslashes and apostrophes); reading with `dotenv_values(interpolate=False)` must reproduce exact value. Preserve existing quote modes and export behavior. Constraint: Only edit src/dotenv/main.py; do not modify tests, docs, other modules, or dependencies. Finish once implementation is ready.

TASK_TRACKING: Task: Fix backslash round-trip in set_key — Status: IN_PROGRESS (implementation applied, verification pending)

COMPLETED:
- Diagnosed bug: set_key only escaped `'`→`\'`; literal backslashes passed verbatim. Trailing `\` escapes closing quote (`'a\'`); consecutive `\\` collapsed by parser's decode_escapes (`_single_quote_escapes` = `\\[\\']`), so `'a\\b'` reads back as `a\b`. Round-trip fails for both `always` and `auto`.
- Applied fix in set_key (main.py ~line 184): escape backslashes before apostrophes when quoting: `value_to_set.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("'", "\\'")`.

PENDING:
- Verify fix correctness (round-trip for trailing backslash, consecutive backslashes, apostrophes).
- Confirm no other files modified.
